question: Where is the nearest restaurant situated on the way toward Best Western Plus Chain Of Lakes Inn & Suites, Leesburg, FL from Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue, FL?
sql: WITH origin_poi AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_poi AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Best Western Plus Chain Of Lakes Inn & Suites%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(o.geom, d.geom) AS line_geom FROM origin_poi o, destination_poi d ), route_corridor AS ( -- Create a 500-meter buffer around the straight line path SELECT ST_Buffer(rl.line_geom, 500) AS corridor_geom FROM route_line rl ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT corridor_geom FROM route_corridor)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT line_geom FROM route_line)) ASC LIMIT 1;
